hypothesis: Selecting camera occlusions, silhouettes and contrast-supported creases avoids uniformly outlining every semantic partition while preserving the unchanged S3 form.
classification: Camera occlusion is hard. Otherwise angle<12deg or linear contrast<5/255 is lost; angle>=35deg and contrast>=16/255 is hard; remaining supported creases are soft.
control: All semantic outlines equally hard. Candidate masks derive from geometry, not screenshots.
decision: All fixed scenes must preserve unselected image regions, bound ink area/error/DOM and omit weak geometry edges. Artistic superiority requires actual human review; this gate cannot certify it.
